announce.mcp-tools-changed-note: A CLI agent reads Navide's MCP tool list once, when it starts. Anything still connected from the previous version ({from}) — a CLI pane, or an external MCP client — keeps the tools it saw then; reopen the pane or reconnect the client to pick up new ones.
announce.scheduler-disabled: Scheduled job "{name}" was disabled: its target pane is gone
announce.scheduler-disabled-note: Its target pane could not be found {n} runs in a row, so the job was disabled. In the Schedule panel, use "Rebind" to point it at a live pane, then enable it again.

status.waiting-safe: {agent}: waiting for a safe moment to switch to {target}
status.partial: {agent}: switched to {target}, some panes did not resume
status.unreconciled: {agent}: an account switch was not reconciled

reason.unverified-adapter: {agent}'s account switching is not verified on this platform; switch manually.
reason.no-resume: {agent} cannot resume its conversation automatically. Switch manually to keep this window and open a new conversation.
reason.no-candidate: No account to switch to. Sign in to another account or wait for the reset.
reason.auto_budget_exhausted: Automatic switch limit reached. Switch manually or wait for the window to pass.
reason.chained-exhaustion: {target} ran out as well. Nothing else was tried.
reason.pane-unowned: A pane in this switch belongs to no open window.
reason.pane-no-session: A pane has no session to resume, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-not-resumable: A pane cannot be resumed, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-refused: A pane refused the switch, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-unsupported: A pane cannot take part in a switch, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-input-pending: A pane holds unsent input, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-permission-pending: A pane is waiting on a permission prompt, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-resume-data-missing: A pane could not name the session to resume, so nothing was switched.
reason.pane-idle-unverified: A pane's idle state could not be verified, so nothing was switched.
reason.platform-unsupported: {agent}'s account switching is not available on this platform.
reason.identity-unknown: The account behind the current sign-in could not be identified, so nothing was switched.
reason.credential-override: The panes take their credential from the environment; a switch would not reach them.
reason.pane-scope-unknown: A pane's provider scope is unknown, so nothing was switched.
reason.credential-source-unknown: Where {agent}'s credential comes from could not be determined (environment variable or provider scope), so nothing was switched.
reason.live-drift: The live credential belongs to another account and the target slot is not empty; reconcile before switching.
reason.live-drift-unverified: The live credential changed and its identity cannot be verified; nothing was switched. Switch manually to confirm which account is live.
reason.audit-write-failed: Credentials were switched but the audit record could not be written; automatic switching pauses until it can.
reason.incident-closed: The incident was closed before the switch completed.
reason.interrupted-swap: A credential swap was interrupted; which account is live is unknown. Pick the live one to reconcile.
reason.unreconciled: An earlier switch left the saved default and the live account out of step; reconcile before switching again.
reason.identity-mismatch: The account you picked does not match the credential that is live ({identity}).
reason.persist-failed: The default could not be saved again; the switch stays unreconciled.
reason.prepare-timeout: Not every pane answered in time, so nothing was switched.
reason.wait-timeout: Panes stayed busy for 30 minutes, so nothing was switched.
reason.stale-state: The account changed underneath the switch, so it was dropped.
reason.new-pane-during-prepare: A new pane opened during the switch, so it was dropped.
reason.pane-became-busy: A pane became busy during the switch, so it was dropped.
reason.login-pending: A sign-in is in progress; switch after it completes.
reason.login-harvest-failed: The current sign-in could not be saved, so nothing was switched.
reason.swap-failed: Switching to {target} failed; {source} is still active. Nothing else was tried.
reason.default-persist-failed: Credentials were switched but the default could not be saved; check Settings before continuing.
reason.resume-failed: Switched to {target}, but resuming failed. Panes keep their state; nothing was replayed.
reason.target-exhausted: {target} is out of quota too. Nothing else was tried.
reason.quota-unconfirmed: Switched to {target}, but no reading confirmed its quota within 120 s. Later readings only update this row.
reason.policy-changed: Automatic switching was turned off during the switch.
reason.quota-confirmed: {target}'s quota was read and has headroom.
reason.turn-complete: {target} completed a turn after the switch; its quota was not read.
reason.outgoing-recovered: {source} recovered on its own; no switch was needed.
reason.unattributed: The signal could not be tied to an account, so nothing was switched.
reason.usage-window-disagrees: The account's own reading does not show the quota as spent, so nothing was switched.
reason.no-declared-detector: {agent} declares no exhaustion signal, so this text only informs.
reason.text-did-not-match: The text did not match {agent}'s declared exhaustion signal, so nothing was switched.

quota.reset-expected: {source} is expected back around {time} (not verified). No automatic switch back.
quota.actions-withdrawn: These options are no longer current.
quota.untrusted: Not verified: no switch was started.
quota.not-switched: {count} pane(s) not switched: their credential comes from the environment.
quota.blocked: Account switching for this CLI is paused until the earlier switch is reconciled.
quota.confirm-new-conversation-body: {agent} cannot resume its conversation on another account. Switching to {target} keeps this pane as it is (on the old account, not resumed) and opens a new conversation on {target}. Credentials change only if you confirm.
quota.confirm-new-conversation-confirm: Keep this pane and open a new conversation

devtime.title: Development time
devtime.reset-confirm: Wipe all development-time records for this workspace? This cannot be undone.

dockWindow.resumes-in-window: This AI panel lives in {window}. It resumes there, not as a pane in this window.
dockWindow.address-title: Other panes reach this panel at {'@'}{address}
dockWindow.roster-error: Other panes cannot reach this panel, and its Navide tools are refused: {reason}

statusBadges.intro: Rename any pane status and pick its colour. Changes apply everywhere a status is shown — the pane badge, the sidebar, the meeting strip and the resource panel — and are saved to your account, not to a project.

when.idle: Finished its turn, waiting at the prompt
when.awaiting: Blocked on a permission or a question
when.error: Failed to start, or the terminal errored

statusBadges.note: An empty name falls back to the built-in translation. Colours resolve through theme tokens, so a choice stays readable in every theme.

preview.cannot-display-text: This file type cannot be displayed as text.
preview.pdf-unavailable: The embedded PDF viewer is not available in this window.
preview.raw-error: Could not load this file for preview.
preview.empty-hint: Click a file, or let an agent push something here.

restore.dialog-message: The app didn't close properly last time. Reopen {count} workspace(s)?
restore.skipped-message: These workspaces failed to open 3 times in a row, so they were left closed to keep the app usable. You can open them again yourself at any time.
restore.scope-message: This workspace has {count} previous session(s). Choose what to resume.
restore.session-not-found: Couldn't find {agent}'s previous conversation — opened a new one instead.
restore.session-unavailable: {agent}'s saved conversation is unavailable, so its placeholder was kept.
restore.session-unknown: Couldn't verify {agent}'s saved conversation, so its placeholder was kept.

backfill.title: Backfilling historical token usage in the background

log.no-path: Waiting for the backend to report its log path…

orphans.title: Leftover CLI processes
orphans.confirm: Found {count} leftover CLI process(es) from a previous run — they can exhaust memory. Clean them up?

reconnect.banner: {count} conversation(s) may have been disconnected — click to recover
reconnect.banner-title: Open the manual picker to reconnect a conversation
reconnect.modal-hint: Pick a previous conversation to reconnect to this pane:
reconnect.failed: Could not reconnect that conversation — its transcript may no longer exist

cli-account.swap-failed: Account switch failed — the previous account is still active.
cli-account.panes-running: {count} running CLI pane(s) are using this account — close them before switching.
cli-account.live-changed: The signed-in {agent} account changed after this notice, so nothing was switched. Check Settings → Accounts.
cli-account.switch-rate-limited: Too many account switches — try again in {seconds}s.
cli-account.switch-restart-confirm-body: Switching accounts will restart {count} running {agent} pane(s). Continue?
cli-account.switch-restart-partial: {failed} of {total} pane(s) could not be restarted after the account switch — see the log for details.
cli-account.needs-login: This account is signed out — starting a sign-in.
cli-account.needs-login-expired: This account's token expired while it was parked — starting a sign-in to renew it.
cli-account.preflight-unknown-scope: This slot's provider is not one {agent} declares — pick a provider from the list.
cli-account.preflight-scope-mismatch: This account belongs to a different {agent} provider than the one in use.
cli-account.preflight-shadowed-by-env: The pane environment sets {vars}, which overrides the signed-in credential — the switch would not take effect.
cli-account.preflight-platform-unsupported: Account switching for {agent} is not available on this platform.
cli-account.preflight-unsupported: {agent} does not support account switching yet.
cli-account.preflight-identity-unknown: The current {agent} sign-in could not be identified, so it cannot be parked safely.
cli-account.preflight-unreconciled: An earlier {agent} switch is not reconciled — complete it from the announcement first.
cli-account.preflight-credential-source-unknown: Where {agent}'s credential comes from could not be determined (environment variable or provider scope), so nothing was switched.
cli-account.login-in-progress: A {agent} sign-in is {state} — switch after it completes.
cli-account.login-blocked-by-live-panes: {count} running {agent} pane(s) block signing in — close or finish them first.
cli-account.live-drift: The live {agent} credential is not the current account and the target slot is not empty — reconcile from the announcement first.
cli-account.adopted-live-login: The live sign-in already was the selected account; it was adopted into its slot without a swap.
cli-account.plaintext-token-store: This Copilot installation stores its token in plain text (storeTokenPlaintext); Navide cannot switch its accounts safely, so nothing was changed.
cli-account.live-drift-unverified: {agent}'s live credential changed and its identity cannot be verified — nothing was switched.
cli-account.live-drift-confirm-title: Is the live credential still the current account?
cli-account.live-drift-confirm-body: {agent}'s live credential changed since it was last saved, and this CLI stores no identity Navide could check it against. Continue only if you are certain it is still {current} (a normal token refresh, not another sign-in). If you continue, Navide keeps the live credential as {current} and switches to {target}.

cliDrop.source-closed: CLI pane is no longer open
cliDrop.fetch-failed: Could not fetch CLI pane output
cliDrop.empty: CLI pane has no output yet

switchWorkspace.failed: Could not switch to {name}. It may have been opened in another window in the meantime — the sidebar will say so.
switchWorkspace.confirm: The pipeline running in this project will be stopped — a pipeline belongs to the project it was started in and cannot keep running in the background. Its agents stay open, and so does everything in the other projects.
switchWorkspace.renameFailed: Could not rename {name} — {reason}. The name was not saved.

closeAll.label: close all
closeAll.title: Close all sessions and tabs (history kept)
closeAll.confirm: Close all {count} session(s) and their tabs? Agent history is kept — this only frees the resources used by this project.

cli-env.denied: {label}: Navide manages {keys} itself, so the value you set never reached the CLI.
cli-env.overridden: {label}: {keys} was accepted but then replaced by Navide's own setting, so your value is not in effect in this pane.

install-terminal.input-lost: Typing did not reach the command: {error}. Anything typed since (e.g. a password) was not received.
install-terminal.running: Running — if it asks for a password or a confirmation, type it here.
install-terminal.exited-fail: Failed with exit code {code}. The output above says why.
install-terminal.lost: The connection to the backend was lost, so the command was stopped.
install-terminal.fallback-title: The built-in terminal could not start
install-terminal.fallback-desc: Run the command in an external Terminal window instead, then re-detect.

cli-install.title: Install {label}
cli-install.lead: {label} is not installed on this machine. Navide can run the vendor's own install command for you — nothing else is downloaded or modified.
cli-install.chain-desc: {label} needs {count} steps on this machine. Start it and each step continues into the next by itself — you only step in where the terminal below asks you something.
cli-install.note-terminal: This runs in a terminal inside this dialog, so you can follow its output and answer any prompt it asks (password, sign-in).
cli-install.no-install-command: {label} has no automatic install command. Follow the vendor's instructions, then re-detect.
cli-install.requirement-manual: {name} is missing and cannot be installed from here — install it manually, then try again.
cli-install.installed-not-detected: The command finished, but {label} still isn't detected. It may need a new terminal session, or it landed outside PATH.
cli-install.signin-title: {label} is installed, but not signed in
cli-install.signin-desc: The command is on your PATH, but it has no account behind it yet — a pane would open on {label}’s own sign-in prompt.
cli-install.signin-hint: This opens a pane that runs the sign-in for you. Most CLIs then open your browser; finish there and come back.

file.unreviewed: An agent asked to install this file. Navide has not reviewed it. Approving opens the same install dialog as "Install from file", and what installs is the copy Navide read when the agent asked, with the SHA-256 above.
file.unreviewed-folder: An agent asked to load this developer folder. Navide has not reviewed it and its contents can change at any time. Approving opens the same dialog as loading a folder yourself.
file.digestChanged: The file Navide holds for this request is not the one shown on the request; nothing was installed. Ask the agent to send it again.
file.card: What this package declares (from a local file, not the Navide Marketplace)
file.no-card: There is no disclosure for this local package. It comes from a local file, not the Navide Marketplace, and Navide has not reviewed it.

title.install-file: Install the Navide plugin {plugin} {version} from a file?
title.update: Update the Navide plugin {plugin} from {from} to {version}?
title.rollback: Roll the Navide plugin {plugin} back from {from} to {version}?

plugin-request.desc: An agent asked for this change. Nothing changes until you approve it here; the agent cannot approve it for you.
plugin-request.tainted: This pane is marked External influence: it has read content from outside Navide (such as a web page or a Navide plugin's text), which may have shaped this request. Check it carefully before you decide.
plugin-request.diff: What changes from the installed version
plugin-request.card: What this version declares (from the Navide Marketplace, not verified yet)
plugin-request.no-card: The Navide Marketplace has no disclosure for this version. The package itself is verified when it is downloaded, before anything is installed.
plugin-request.completed-late: {plugin}: done. Another window had marked this request interrupted while this one reconnected; the record now shows what really happened.
plugin-request.finished-late: Another window had marked this request interrupted while this one reconnected; the record now shows this result instead.
plugin-request.not-appliable: This version of Navide cannot carry out this kind of request yet; you can reject it.
plugin-request.unavailable: Navide plugin actions are not available in this window.

skill-approval.title: Install skill “{name}”?
skill-approval.desc: An agent asked to add this skill. Nothing is written until you approve it here; the agent cannot approve on your behalf.
skill-approval.write-note: Approving writes this skill to the shared skills library and counts as permission for the first write there. Bundled scripts are never run.
skill-approval.expired: This request expired before it was approved. Ask the agent to prepare the skill again.

cli-manage.title: Installation and updates
cli-manage.hint: Navide runs each CLI's own official commands and never updates them itself. Commands come from the built-in registry; the exact command is shown before it runs.
cli-manage.use-failed: Could not switch {label} to this installation: {error}
cli-manage.autoupdate-failed: Could not change {label}'s auto-update setting; it is unchanged.
cli-manage.terminal-opened: Opened in Terminal: {command}. Click Re-detect when it finishes.
cli-manage.command-unavailable: {label} ships no official command for this action.
cli-manage.footnote: Updates replace the binary; sessions already running keep the old one until they restart.

cli-health.override-missing: The {label} install you chose ({path}) was not found, so Navide launches the default one. Choose again in Settings → CLI Agents.
cli-health.override-refused: Navide could not keep the {label} install you chose ({path}): {error}. It launches the default one; choose again in Settings → CLI Agents.
cli-health.title: Navide found an agent CLI setup issue
cli-health.detect-title: See exactly what Navide will run
cli-health.detect-desc: Multiple installations or a failed startup probe can make Terminal and Navide launch different binaries. Review the active path before changing anything.
cli-health.repair-desc: Keep one known-good installation. Remove alternates with the package manager that installed them, then run the CLI's own diagnostic.
cli-health.verify-desc: After finishing in Terminal, run detection again. This guide closes automatically when the issue is gone.
cli-health.keep-primary: Keep the active binary shown by Navide if it is the version you expect.
cli-health.remove-alternate: Remove alternate installations using their original package manager; do not disable macOS security.
cli-health.run-doctor: Run the CLI diagnostic, then return here and re-detect.
cli-health.use-version-note: This is safe and reversible: it changes only the executable Navide launches. It does not uninstall anything or weaken macOS security.
cli-health.removal-blocked: Removal is unavailable because no other working installation was found. Repair or install another copy first, then re-detect.
cli-health.confirm-remove-desc: This opens Terminal to uninstall {version} at {path}. Nothing is removed until you answer "y" in Terminal.
cli-health.confirm-remove-keep: The working installation at {path} stays in place.
cli-health.removal-opened: A confirmation prompt for removing {label} was opened in Terminal. Return here and re-detect when it finishes.
cli-health.save-failed: Could not save your choice: {error}. Try again.
cli-health.binary-selected: {label} will use this version in Navide. The issues below still need attention.
cli-health.still-detected: The issue is still detected. Check the paths above and try again.
cli-health.recheck-failed: Detection failed: {error}. Try again in a moment.

usage.cached-tooltip: Cached quota — hover for refresh details
usage.cached-account-tooltip: Cached — this account could not be polled; numbers are from {time}
usage.reading-now: Reading this account's quota — can take up to 3 minutes
usage.reading-tooltip: This account just became active. Reading its quota starts a Claude Code, so the numbers below are the previous reading until that finishes — up to 3 minutes.
usage.refresh-status-unverified: Not verified yet — open a pane
usage.unverified-tooltip: Not verified yet. Open a pane for this CLI once and its quota will be read from the next refresh.
usage.expired-tooltip: Credentials expired — re-login in that CLI
usage.cli-missing-tooltip: Claude Code is not on Navide's PATH, so its quota cannot be read. Install it, or re-detect it in Settings › CLI.
usage.parked-not-measured-hint: Parked: Claude Code only reports the account it runs as. Sign this account in to its own folder to read its quota live.
usage.exhausted-tooltip: Out of quota — back in {time}. Not the same as “under 1% left”: work sent now is refused
usage.exhausted-tooltip-no-reset: Out of quota — reset time unknown
usage.follow-hint: New panes and {count} following pane(s) use it
usage.follow-hint-none: New panes use it. Mark a pane to follow with the pin beside its account badge.
usage.pinned-hint: {count} pane(s) are fixed to an account's own folder and stay put when you switch.
usage.unpin-all-tooltip: Reopen these panes on the current login so they move with every account switch. Each reopens once and picks up its conversation; one that is working is asked about first.
usage.continue-with-tooltip: Reopen this pane on {account} and resume its conversation
usage.dir-sign-in: Sign in to its own folder
usage.dir-sign-in-tooltip: This account has not signed in inside its own folder yet, so it still runs on the shared login. Sign in once to run it alongside other accounts.
usage.continue-with-confirm-body: This pane reopens on {account} and resumes its conversation. A turn in progress stops. Other panes are not affected.
usage.settings-enabled: Show remaining quota in CLI pane headers
usage.settings-hint: Shows CLI quota for 11 providers: claude, codex, kimi, grok, antigravity, opencode, qwen, kilo, pi, copilot and cursor. Most read local CLI credentials to query that provider's own usage API — read-only, credentials are never written. Claude is different: it drives the Claude CLI's built-in /usage panel instead of reading credentials.
usage.failover-title: Account switch when quota runs out
usage.failover-hint: What Navide does when a CLI account hits its quota: do nothing, list the accounts it could switch to (default), or switch automatically — at most 3 automatic switches per 5 hours per CLI, never back to the exhausted account on its own. The table shows what each CLI can do; the switch itself is decided by the backend.
usage.failover-loop-title: Resume a loop right after switching when quota runs out
usage.failover-loop-hint: When a pane running a loop runs out of quota, switch to an account that still has quota and send continue right away instead of waiting for the reset. Requires "Switch automatically" above.
usage.follow-switch-title: Move pinned panes along when switching Claude accounts
usage.follow-switch-hint: Claude panes running on an account's own sign-in folder do not follow an account switch. With this on, a switch lists them so you can move them along, and an out-of-quota pane gets a "Switch account" button. Each pane reopens on the new account and resumes its conversation. Off by default.
usage.failover-unverified: Not verified on a real account
usage.failover-audit-degraded: The switch audit record could not be written; automatic switching is paused until it can. Manual switching still works.
usage.settings-signing-hint: Dev-only. Writes ~/navide-signing/usage_secrets.py so the next release build bundles Antigravity's public installed-app OAuth constants. Never stored in the repo.

head.permissions: Set up Navide on your computer

aside.environment: Navide drives real CLIs in real terminals — these tools are what it runs on.
aside.agents: Every pane you open runs one of these agents. One is enough to start.
aside.permissions: Grant the access Navide needs to drive your machine.
aside.ready: Everything checks out. The first time through, a short tour you can skip at any point helps you pick a workspace and open your first agent.

onboard.ollama-stopped: Ollama is installed but its service is not running — models cannot be downloaded until it starts.
onboard.notif-test-body: Notifications are on — you'll hear from your agents here.

automation.title: Allow Navide to run install commands in Terminal
automation.desc: Some CLIs must be installed in a real terminal. This lets Navide open Terminal and type the command for you.
automation.why: macOS calls this Automation. Navide only ever sends the install command you clicked — it never reads what is in your terminal windows.
automation.denied: Terminal control was denied. Turn it on in System Settings, then re-detect.
automation.pane-hint: Enable Terminal under Navide in Privacy & Security → Automation.

notifications.title: Allow Navide to notify you
notifications.desc: Get told when an agent finishes, asks a question, or a long task ends — without watching the pane.
notifications.why: Notifications are only sent for your own agents' state changes. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
notifications.denied: Notifications are turned off. Enable them in System Settings, then re-detect.
notifications.pane-hint: Allow notifications for Navide in Notifications.

folders.title: Allow Navide to open your project folders
folders.desc: Workspaces on your Desktop, in Documents or Downloads are protected by macOS. Grant access so they can be opened.
folders.why: macOS asks once per folder. Navide only reads the workspace you pick — no other folder is touched.
folders.denied: Folder access was denied. Enable it in System Settings, then re-detect.
folders.pane-hint: Enable Navide in Privacy & Security → Files and Folders.

fullDisk.title: Allow Navide full disk access
fullDisk.desc: Only needed for workspaces outside your home folder. Optional — you can turn it on later, in System Settings.
fullDisk.why: macOS gives no in-app way to ask for this: it can only be toggled in System Settings. Navide re-checks automatically once you flip it.
fullDisk.denied: Full disk access is off. Toggle Navide on in System Settings — this screen updates by itself.
fullDisk.pane-hint: Toggle Navide on in Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access.

onboard.blocked-by: Install {names} first — it is required before this can be installed here.
onboard.complete-failed: Could not save your setup progress: {error}. Try again.
onboard.ollama-start-failed: Could not start the Ollama service. See the log for details, or run `ollama serve` in a terminal.
onboard.run-by-hand: You can also run this yourself in a terminal: {cmd}
onboard.installed-not-detected: The command finished, but {label} is still not detected. It may need a new shell session, or it landed outside PATH.
onboard.installed-still-outdated: The install finished, but the {label} found on PATH is still the old {version}. The new one may sit behind the system copy — move its directory ahead on PATH, then re-detect. A corrected PATH order takes effect on re-detect, no restart needed.
onboard.installed-still-outdated-python: The install finished, but the {label} found on PATH is still the old {version}. Fix it either way, then re-detect: run brew link --overwrite python{'@'}3.x (with the version you installed), or add eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)" to ~/.zprofile so Homebrew comes before the system copy.

executions.backend-outdated: The backend is older than this window — restart Navide to load scheduled jobs.
executions.no-source: Nothing to list on this platform: Navide reads the user crontab and macOS launchd jobs, and this system has neither. Navide never creates OS scheduled jobs, so nothing is missing here; its own jobs are listed above.
executions.no-source-windows: Windows keeps its scheduled tasks in Task Scheduler (taskschd.msc), which lists, enables, disables and removes them; Navide does not integrate it by design.

confirm.crontab: This crontab entry ({name}) will be permanently removed:
confirm.launchagent: {name} will be unloaded and its plist permanently deleted:

agent.calendar: On a calendar schedule (see the plist)

system.name: Self-evolution · {workspace}

scheduler.gone-disabled: missing {n} runs in a row, disabled
scheduler.rebound-reenable: Rebound to the rebuilt pane, switch it back on

skip.budget_global: Skipped: agents' daily total used up
skip.expired: Expired: agent job not renewed in 7 days

editor.name: Name
editor.text-placeholder: What to send to this pane when the time comes…
editor.err-every: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to {max}
editor.err-tz: Invalid time zone (use an IANA name such as Asia/Taipei)
editor.err-once: Pick a date and time in the future
editor.err-max-runs: Daily limit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}

owner.agent-title: Created by the agent "{name}"; only it and you can change it
owner.gone-title: The pane that created this job is closed; agents can only read it now, and it is yours to manage
owner.expires-title: An agent's periodic job disables itself 7 days after it was last saved or enabled

limit.runs-full: Agent jobs have used today's runs ({runs}/{max}); their remaining slots are skipped until tomorrow

turn-stats.title: Turn Stats
turn-stats.method-inferred-note: Cut at turn-end signals; a long tool call may be split into two turns.
turn-stats.method-unsupported: This CLI does not report token usage.
turn-stats.no-calls: No call details for this turn.
turn-stats.empty-panes: No CLI pane in this window.
turn-stats.error-no-session: This pane has no session to read yet.
turn-stats.error-file-missing: The session transcript is no longer on disk.
turn-stats.note: Claude re-reads the whole context every turn, so Cache R is far larger than the other columns. The tokens figure in the CLI footer is the context size, not a running total.
turn-stats.error-never-started: This pane has never been started, so there is no session to read.

guard.unavailable: Navide Guard is not available from this backend yet. Restart Navide after updating.

enabled.title: Navide Guard
enabled.desc: Judge each CLI action by how dangerous it is and who asked for it; stop or ask before the dangerous ones. The rules are fixed code, never an AI. Approving a high-risk action from a chat channel stays refused even when this is off. Terminal command protection, and the check on an agent answering a prompt through MCP, are not affected by this switch either.

policy.title: What Guard does
policy.hint: Each action is graded, then handled by where the request came from.
policy.levels: Critical: deleting outside the workspace or home, disk/system commands, sudo, curl | sh, touching credentials, force-push to main, cloud teardown. High: rm -rf inside the workspace, git push / reset --hard, publishing packages, editing CI or git hooks.

row.remote: Remote device, other pane or agent

vendors.title: Which CLIs Guard can block
vendors.hint: Guard stops an action through the CLI's own hook. CLIs without one can only be protected by chat-approval refusal and by not running them in YOLO mode.

builtin.title: Built-in rules
builtin.hint: How Guard grades each pattern it recognises. Raising a level applies at once; lowering one or turning it off needs confirmation. Rules marked as a safety floor go down to High at most. The table above (what asks, what is denied) stays fixed.

group.unanalyzable: Cannot be judged statically (Normal by default; a pane with external content still treats them as High)

rule.credential-access: Reads, writes or deletes a credential store
rule.dotenv-outside-workspace: Touches a .env file outside the workspace
rule.sudo: Runs with elevated privileges or as another user
rule.pipe-download-to-shell: Executes content fetched from the network
rule.download-then-exec: Executes a file downloaded in the same command
rule.disk-write: dd writes directly to a device
rule.disk-format: Formats, erases or repartitions a disk
rule.rm-root-or-home: Deletes the root, home, or a parent of the workspace
rule.git-force-push-protected: Force-pushes to or deletes a protected branch
rule.cloud-destroy: Destroys cloud infrastructure or cluster resources
rule.agent-config-write: Writes agent CLI settings (hooks live there)
rule.git-push-force: Force push (history rewrite on the remote)
rule.rm-file-outside-workspace: Deletes a file outside the workspace
rule.rm-unresolved-target: rm target is computed at run time
rule.decode-and-exec: Pipes decoded data into an interpreter
rule.dynamic-command: Command name is computed at run time
rule.nesting-too-deep: Substitutions nested too deep to analyse
rule.stdin-script: Interpreter reads its script from stdin
rule.unknown-script: Runs a script Guard cannot see

branches.title: Protected branches
branches.hint: Force-pushing to or deleting these branches is Critical. Terminal command protection's force-push check uses the same list. Removing a branch needs confirmation.

rules.title: Custom rules
rules.hint: Deny patterns raise a match to Critical or High; allow patterns lower a High match to Normal.
rules.hint-detail: Critical never moves down. On a pane with external content, a command Guard cannot analyse is only released by an allow pattern matching the whole command, e.g. python3 -c *. Adding an allow or removing a deny needs confirmation.

test.title: Test against Guard rules
test.placeholder: Type a shell command, e.g. rm -rf ~
test.unparseable: Cannot be judged statically (variable expansion, eval, encoded script).

terminal.title: Terminal command protection
terminal.hint: Navide refuses these commands when an agent, an MCP client or a scheduled job types them into a plain terminal pane, whatever the Guard switch says. What you type yourself is never checked.
terminal.hint-detail: Each part of a line (split at ; && {'|'}{'|'} {'|'} & and newlines) is checked, and one refused part refuses the whole line.
terminal.loosen-confirm: Switching a category off asks for confirmation; switching one on does not.

category.rm-system: Recursive delete of root, home or outside the workspace
category.privilege: Running as another user or administrator
category.disk: Formatting, erasing or raw-writing a disk
category.mass-kill: Killing processes by name or pattern
category.recursive-perms: Recursive permission or owner change on root, home or system folders
category.pipe-to-shell: Running a script straight from the network
category.force-push-main: Force-pushing to or deleting main / master
category.classifier-high: Anything else Guard rates high (git push, git reset --hard, rm -rf inside the workspace)
category.unanalyzable: Lines that cannot be judged statically

block.title: Extra block patterns
block.hint: Refuse any part of a line matching one of these. Plain text matches anywhere; * ? [ ] make it a glob.

allow.title: Allow exceptions
allow.warning: A part of a line that starts with one of these prefixes skips every built-in check above — only add commands you fully trust. Block patterns still apply, and a download piped into a shell is never allowed. Adding one asks for confirmation.
allow.placeholder: Exact command prefix, e.g. git push origin

problem.too-long: The pattern is longer than 500 characters.
problem.control: The pattern contains a control character.
problem.match-all: This pattern would match every command.

taint.title: Panes with external influence
taint.hint: A pane that received content from a chat app, a remote device, another pane or an MCP caller asks here before any High or Critical action, until you clear it.

welcome.pickFolder: First, pick a folder for your agents to work in. Have a project? Click Browse…. Starting fresh? Click New…. Just trying it out? Click Home.
welcome.openAgent: Click ＋ and pick a CLI to open your first agent.
welcome.firstCommand: Type a sentence here and press Enter, then watch it answer.
welcome.talkMention: Open one more pane, then type {'@'} in either pane and pick the other to give it a task.
welcome.talkDrag: Or drag one pane’s title bar onto another pane’s terminal to bring its conversation along.
welcome.usageAccount: Rest the pointer here to see the quota and account, and switch accounts right here if you need to.
welcome.usageAccountMissing: The quota and account show up here, on the pane’s title bar. They are not there yet because this CLI’s quota has not been read (a new pane takes a moment; some CLIs have none). Once the badge appears, rest the pointer on it to see the quota and switch accounts.
welcome.finished: Tour complete. You can see it again from Help → First-Run Tour….
welcome.missing: What this step points at isn’t on screen right now. You can press Next to move on.

welcome.title: Two new things in 0.2.10
welcome.body:
Channels lets you drive a pane from a chat app, and Voice Input lets you dictate into one. This tour shows where each lives — it only points, it changes nothing.

→ / Enter next · ← back · Esc leave

channelsSettings.title: Set up a chat platform once
channelsSettings.body: Pick a platform — Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Matrix, Mattermost or iMessage — and fill in its bot credentials. Credentials are kept in the credential vault on this machine.

channelsPane.title: Connect a pane to a chat
channelsPane.body: This chat button in a pane's header binds the pane to one chat location. Messages from that chat become instructions for the pane, and its answer is sent back when the turn ends.
channelsPane.missing: Open a CLI pane: the chat button sits in its header, next to the quota badge.

voiceSettings.title: Turn Voice Input on
voiceSettings.body: Voice Input is off by default. Switch it on here, download the speech model and choose your microphone. You can also change the shortcut on this page.
voiceSettings.missing: Find it under Settings → Voice Input.

voiceDictate.title: Hold the key and talk
voiceDictate.body: Click into a pane, hold the dictation shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+M unless you changed it) and speak. Words appear as you talk and are typed into the pane when you let go — nothing is sent. Press Enter during a take to end it and send.
voiceDictate.missing: Open a CLI pane, click into it, then hold the dictation shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+M unless you changed it) and speak.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: Reopen it any time from Help → What's New… — the tour button is there.
